data.title: A 0.4V 7nm Independent-Gate FinFET SRAM with Dynamic Reverse Body Biasing
data.abstract: We present an independent-gate 7nm FinFET SRAM macro operating reliably down to 0.4V with 48% reduction in standby leakage current via dynamic reverse body biasing.

data.title: Analytical Static Noise Margin Modeling for Near-Threshold FinFET SRAM Cells
data.abstract: We formulate closed-form analytical models for hold and read static noise margins under non-Gaussian FinFET process variation.
